question: In what way do both this scripture and this world share the guru as their root?
premises: This scripture is described as rooted in the guru.
This world is described as rooted in the guru.
The same root is attributed to both scripture and world.
inference: Therefore, the guru is the common foundational root of both scripture and world.
plain_english: This scripture has the guru as its root; this world has the guru as its root.
